QuemSomos.metaDescription: Meet yzevtech and how we work: understand the problem, design the solution, then build and evolve software, automation and digital products.
QuemSomos.heroLead: Yzev builds software, automations, and digital solutions for companies ready to grow.
QuemSomos.comoPensamosTitle: We design technology from real problems.
QuemSomos.comoPensamosParagraph1: Not every problem needs a new system. Not every task needs to be automated. Not every idea needs to start big.
QuemSomos.comoPensamosParagraph2: We start by understanding how the work actually happens. Then we figure out what can be simplified, automated, turned into software, or built as a product.

automacaoIa.title: Automation & AI
automacaoIa.text: Repetitive tasks automated, so your team spends time on what actually needs attention.

softwareWeb.title: Software & Web
softwareWeb.text: Systems, websites, and platforms built around the way your business really works.

saasMicrosaas.title: SaaS & MicroSaaS
saasMicrosaas.text: Internal solutions validated in-house and turned into products other companies can use.

entender.title: Understand
entender.text: Map the problem and understand how the work really happens.

projetar.title: Design
projetar.text: Find the right solution before we start building.

construir.title: Build
construir.text: Turn the idea into software, automation, or a product.

evoluir.title: Evolve
evoluir.text: Improve the solution as new needs come up.

QuemSomos.closingLine1: We don't believe in technology for technology's sake.
QuemSomos.closingLine2: We build solutions so the next step actually makes sense.
